settings_checker_desc_friendly: Meusapat komputer droeneuh keu neusambong ngon peumaen droeneuh dan neupasang pembaroan perangkat lunak deungon cara nyang jeuet neuandalkan.
settings_checker_desc: Meusapat komputer droeneuh keu neusambong ngon peumaen droeneuh dan neupasang pembaroan perangkat lunak deungon cara nyang jeuet neuandalkan.

linux_prep_fix_body: Kata sandi droeneuh peureulèë sigo keu neupeugot komputer nyoe keu neu-flash: aturan USB keu alat MediaTek ngon akses port serial.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Keu neupeugot komputer nyoe keu SP Flash Tool, kata sandi droeneuh akan dipeureulee bak langkah selanjut jih keu neukonfigurasi aturan USB dan neutamah akun droeneuh keu kelompok pengguna serial nyang dipeureulee. Meunyo neu tulak, aplikasi nyan akan ditutop.

home_desc: Teume firmware online atawa pileh paket lokal, lheuh nyan flash bak alat droeneuh.

settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install: Bimbing lon melalui install lam app .

settings_terminal_desc_windows: Meujalankan pemasangan perangkat lunak droeneuh lam Command Prompt supaya droeneuh jeut neu kalon info teknis teuntang kemajuan.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Hana wajeb. Padum-padum boh target MediaTek hana jitem flash sampoe SP Flash Tool geubri file otentikasi (.auth); tambahkan droeneuh disino meunyo alat nyan peureulee.

{terminal_name} jinoe akan buka lari {method}.

sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Pasang melalui GUI Alat Flash SP .

SP Flash Tool GUI will now open with your firmware preloaded.

• In SP Flash Tool, select "Download" from the dropdown box.

{hint}

Click OK to launch SP Flash Tool and exit Updater.

support_story_1_lead: Meulindông alat droëneuh nibak jeubak peurangkat keras nyang hana su ngon revisi nyang brok.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis sabe geupeuteubiet firmware nyang leubeh baroe keu peumaen lagee Y1 (geutargetkan revisi papan nyang teusöm lagee 6.0, 7.0, ngon 8.0) nyang hana su ji peubreuk alat-alat nyang leubeh tuha. Leubeh brok lom, situs web awak nyan geubri peringatan nol dan akses nol keu firmware nyang ka keurija seugolom jih untuk puleh dari keadaan bata. Updater ngon proyek Community Firmware jicok potongan-potongan: kamoe meuarsip tiep ROM stok warisan, otomatis meuverifikasi revisi perangkat keras droeneuh, ngon menjaga pemain droeneuh beu aman.

support_story_2_headline: Hana Google Drive nyang rusak. Hana teubak-teubak. Cuma keurija firmware.
support_story_2_lead: Infrastruktur komunitas nyang berkecepatan tinggi dan terverifikasi nyang jeut droeneuh peucaya beutoi-beutoi.
support_story_2_body: Meulacak perangkat lunak resmi Innioasis biasa jih meuarti meulacak forum keu link Google Drive nyang ka kadaluarsa, saham awan Baidu nyang ka mate, ngon file zip misteri hana alat nyang meukilat. Kamoe meubangun jaringan download nyang jeuet dipeucaya, independen ngon integritas SHA-256 nyang ka diverifikasi, pemberitahuan pembaroan, ngon pemasangan nyang dibimbing langkah-demi-langkah. Sumbangan droeneuh langsong neukeubah download dan hosting nyang jeut keu mungken 24 jeum siuroe, 365 uroe sithon.

support_story_3_lead: Meuba Rockbox, sistem operasi ringan khusus, ngon keubebasan audiophile.
support_story_3_body: Perangkat lunak pabrek saham hanya menggaruk permukaan peu nyang jeut dipeugot le hardware Y1 atawa Y2 droeneuh. Komunitas kamoe geuba Rockbox, sistem operasi khusus nyang ringan, peumeu'en codec audiophile, ngon tema khusus keu udep. Kamoe meubloe variasi perangkat keras fisik dari saku keu tes, rekayasa balik, ngon verifikasi tiep-tiep pasang. Meudukong Updater langsong geubi dana keu unit-unit tes nyoe ngon geupeuceupat pengembangan firmware khusus.

Innioasis hana geubri dukungan Linux, hana changelog transparan, ngon hana cara mudah keu geupeupuléh watèe saboh install gagal. retry_guidance_step_3: 3. Tapasang lom kabel USB, lheuh nyan ta cuba lom.

flash_watch_timeout_hint: Cek ka ji pasang dan ka ji peuhidup. Meunyo teutap seupôt, neuteugon saboh pin lam lubang reset dan neumat tombol teungoh (Y1) atawa tombol power (peumaen laen) keu neupeudong lom. Meunyo mantong hana akan mulai, firmware hana jicok, pasang laen.

action_flash_complete: Kilat lengkap! Putuskan USB dan reboot.

action_da_stall: Alat hana le geujaweub watee geukonfigurasi agen download. Peumate daya jih mandum, sambung lom, dan cuba lom.
action_detected_brom: Alat nyang ka jiteumee (mode BROM) - jikonfigurasi agen unduhan...
action_detected_preloader: Alat ka jiteumee (mode pramuat) - jikonfigurasi agen unduhan...
action_da_wait_back: Peumaen nyan hana le geujaweub watee geumulai agen download. Teungoh preh jih teuka lom...

err_code_partition_table_invalid: Verifikasi tabel partisi hana meuhasé lheuëh geutuléh .
err_sp_wrong_model: Kamoe ka salah sambung model pemain. Klik tombol × keu neubatasi install nyoe, lheuh nyan neupileh software keu player nyang ka neukonek.
err_sp_timeout: Alat nyan hana tom deuh bak peumaen. Jaga beu mate dan neucok colokan, lheuh nyan neusambong kabel USB watee neuyue.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Peumaen power up that awai. Power off sepenuh jih, lheuh nyan sambung lom.
err_sp_download_fail: Tuleh ka terputus. Cek kabel USB ngon port dan charge baterai, lheuh nyan neu cuba lom.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Agen download hana jeuet geumulai. Neucuba cara flash nyang laen.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Agen download hana jeut geukirém keu peumaen. Peumate daya dan sambung lom.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Peumaen nyan geutulak agen download (kesalahan 6104). Pakèk Agen Download nyang ka geubungkôh ngon SP Flash Tool, dan neupareksa beu firmware jih cocok ngon peumeu'èn nyoe.
err_sp_com_port: Alat nyan hana jeuet jibuka port serial jih. Tutup alat-alat flashing laen dan sambungkan lom.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Port USB COM hana jeuet jibuka (kesalahan 1013). Meunyo neu restart komputer akan neu peulheuh port nyang ka teukunci. Neupeuhah lom komputer droeneuh dan neucuba lom.'
err_sp_enable_dram: Alat nyan hana jeuet jipeuphon memori peumaen. Pakèk paket nyang ka geupeugot keu model nyang tepat nyoe.
err_sp_storage_read: Alat nyan hana jeuet jibaca teumpat simpan peumaen. Cek sambungan; alat nyan mungken na salah hardware.
err_attempt_timeout: Alat nyang meukedip-kedip nyan hana jipeuleumah kemajuan lam watee {seconds} detik, jadi usaha nyoe ka jitheun.
err_connection_failed_desc: Hana jeuet geupeugot hubongan nyang stabil ngon peumaen. Pastikan alat nyan ka mate (pakek pin untuk neutekan tombol reset meunyoe peureulee), cabut USB, dan sambungkan lom watee diyue.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Kedip-kedip ka terputus atawa operasi tuleh ka gagal. Cek kabel USB ka teuga dan baterai ka cukop charge, lheuh nyan neu cuba lom.
err_mtk_output_stall_title: Kilat nyan deuh jih ka meusangkôt .
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Alat flashing ka jipeuleumah gareh nyang saban seulama {seconds} detik nyang ka u likot dan hana deuh jisambong tuleh firmware. Mungken flash nyan ka gagal. Meunyo nyoe nakeuh nyang akhé nibak dua boh usaha ngon tiep-tiep metode bak saboh sistem nyang jeuet rhet lom antara awaknyan, atawa meunyo MTKClient mantong nyang na bak meusén nyoe, restart komputer dan cuba lom.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: Hanya MTKClient nyang na keu pasang nyoe. Mungken flash nyan ka gagal. Neupeudong lom komputer dan neucuba lom.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Komputer nyoe jeut cit neupasang ngon neupakek SP Flash Tool. Meunyo jeut, neugantoe keu SP Flash Tool dan neucuba lom.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Mungken flash nyan ka gagal. Neu baca peusan di ateuh dan neu restart komputer sigohlom neu cuba lom. Meunyo neu klik OK, app nyan akan berhenti sehingga jeut neu restart.
err_missing_package_files_title: Paket perangkat lunak nyang hana sah
err_missing_package_files_desc: Paket firmware nyan hana file scatter atawa file gamba nyang dipeureulee. Neu-download lom paket nyan atawa neupiléh file firmware nyang lengkap.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: File otentikasi nyang neupiléh hana, kosong atawa hana jeuet neutuléh. Pileh file nyang sah, atawa clear lam Settings, lheuh nyan flash lom.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Alat nyang meukedip-kedip atawa driver sistem nyang dipeureulee hana jeuet geu-inisialisasi. Neupareksa izin sistem, neupeugot driver, atawa neupasang lom aplikasi nyan.
err_driver_missing_desc: Kesalahan nyoe jeut teuka watee driver USB MediaTek hana dipasang. Klik Unduh Driver keu neupasang driver USB MediaTek, neupeugot lom komputer droeneuh, dan neucuba lom.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Saboh file firmware nyang ka teu-cache hana le. Pileh Pileh Perangkat Lunak keu neubangun lom file-file nyang ka neu ekstrak atawa neu download lom arsip firmware. Nyoe masalah file lokal, kon masalah koneksi USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Neugisa lom bak Pileh Perangkat Lunak keu neubangun lom atawa neu-download paket firmware.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Pileh saboh rilis firmware keu neu download lom.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Kesalahan nyang hana teuduga teuka watee peugot ({detail}). Peumaté daya peumeu'èn seucara mandum, sambung lom meunyoë geuyuë, dan cuba lom.
flash_method_confirm: Cara pasang geu ubah jeut keu {method}. Konfirmasi player ka ji cabut dan ka mate, lheuh nyan klik Next.
flash_failover_note: {method} hana meuteumeung mulai pasang. Lheueh peumaen nyan mate dan dipeuhah, {other} akan dipakek seubagoe gantoe.
themepack_card_desc: Meunan cit tema komunitas nyang lagak, latar resolusi tinggi, ngon font nyang jipeugot khusus keu tampilan 360p.
themepack_step1_title: Langkah 1: Sambong lam Mode Penyimpanan USB .
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Peuhidup peumaen droeneuh deungon neumat tombol Power.
2. Meunyo Rockbox ka boot, neupasang kabel USB lam komputer droeneuh.
3. Meunyo diyue bak layar player, konfirmasi mode USB Storage supaya alat nyan deuh lagee drive.
themepack_step2_title: Langkah 2: Pileh Folder Peu mantong bak Player .
themepack_step2_desc: Kareuna sistem operasi (lagee macOS) jisom dotfile (lagee .rockbox) seucara default, droeneuh jeuet neupileh folder PEU MANTONG atawa root drive bak peumeu'en droeneuh. Kamoe akan otomatis meurumpok atawa peugot direktori .rockbox keu droeneuh.
themepack_complete: Pak tema berhasil dipasang! Jinoe jeuet neupeuputôh peumaen droeneuh ngon aman dan neupiléh saboh tema lam Rockbox (Pengaturan > Pengaturan Tema).
themepack_err_not_found: Hana jeuet neuteumeung atawa neu-inisialisasi direktori .rockbox bak drive nyang ka neupiléh. Neupastikan droeneuh neupileh saboh folder bak player droeneuh.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Langkah 1: Restart peumaen dan sambung lom .
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Peuhah kabel USB.
2. Peuhidup lom peumaen dan peubiyeu boot lam Rockbox.
3. Meunyo ka Rockbox ka meujalan, tapeusambong lom kabel USB, lheuh nyan tapeuget Continue.
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App nyan teungoh ji kalon koneksi ADB (sampoe 30 detik). Meunyo na alat nyang meuteumeung, tema-tema nyan jipinah dan peumaen ji-reboot otomatis. Meunyo hana, neujak laju u Mode Penyimpanan USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_found: Alat nyang ka meuteumeung ({serial}); meupinah tema...
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Hana alat ADB nyang jiteumee lam watee 30 detik; meusambong ngon Mode Penyimpanan USB.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Hana biner ADB nyang na bak app; meusambong ngon Mode Penyimpanan USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Meudorong tema ngon font ateuh ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Pemindahan ADB hana meuhasé; rhet lom keu Mode Penyimpanan USB .
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Peugot Mode Penyimpanan USB bak player supaya deuh lagee drive.
2. Pileh PEU MANTONG folder bak peumeuen di miyup nyoe (.rockbox, Musik, Tema, atawa root drive, saboh folder .rockbox nyang teusöm na diteumee secara otomatis).
3. App nyan ji gabungkan tema ngon font 360p lam, ji timpa file nyang nan jih saban.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Jinoe jeuet neupeuputoh peumaen ngon aman dan neupiléh saboh tema lam Rockbox (Pengaturan > Pengaturan Tema).
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Software barô droëneuh ka neupasang, tapi folder .rockbox tuha hana jeuët neubôh. Hapus folder .rockbox bak player ngon jaroe meunyo neuk neuk mulai gleh.

rockbox_stage_pushing: Peumaen ka jiteumee. Peuduek tema & font komunitas...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Peutheun tombol teungoh keu neu peuhidup Y1 droeneuh, neu sambung lom USB, dan neu pileh Mode Penyimpanan USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Peutheun tombol power keu peuhidup peumeu'en, sambungkan lom USB, dan pileh Mode Penyimpanan USB.
rockbox_recover_troubleshoot: Perangkat hana mulai? Neupeugot lom perangkat lunak asli .

rockbox_step_standalone_power_on_usb: Neupasang kabel USB bak {model} droeneuh, lheuh nyan neutekan Next.
rockbox_step_select_rockbox_folder: Neupiléh peumeu'èn nyan keudroe atawa folder .rockbox .
rockbox_select_device_prompt: Peumaen pat nyang neupasang tema Rockbox?
rockbox_select_software_question: Software peu nyang teungoh meujalan bak player droeneuh?

rockbox_step2_connect_usb_storage: Neusambong {model} droeneuh ngon mode transfer USB .
